local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Main ScreenGui

screenGui.Name = "HHJ_Macro_Hub"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Helper Function to Create Stylish Rounded Drag Frames
local function createStyledCard(pos, size)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = size
    frame.Position = pos
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Active = true
    frame.Draggable = true
    frame.Parent = screenGui

    local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    uiCorner.Parent = frame

    local uiGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    uiGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30))
    })
    uiGradient.Rotation = 45
    uiGradient.Parent = frame

    local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    uiStroke.Thickness = 1.5
    uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 110)
    uiStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    uiStroke.Parent = frame

    return frame
end

-- Core Functionality Definitions
local function tiltCharacter45()
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local humanoidRoot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRoot then return end

    local originalCF = humanoidRoot.CFrame
    local tiltCF = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
    humanoidRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(originalCF.Position) * tiltCF * originalCF.Rotation
end

local isSpinning = false
local function rotateCamera(deg)
    local root = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local newCFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(deg), 0) * Camera.CFrame
    Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position) * newCFrame.Rotation
end

local function runSpinSequence(duration)
    if isSpinning then return end
    isSpinning = true
    local startTime = tick()

    task.spawn(function()
        while tick() - startTime < duration do
            rotateCamera(-180)
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            rotateCamera(180)
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        isSpinning = false
    end)
end

-- Spin Active Duration Setting Input

-- Delta Roblox Compact Rocket & Hack Panel (Set Point 1 & 2 Included)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

-- Ayarlar & Durumlar
local walkSpeedVal = 16
local maxJumps = 5
local jumpCount = 0
local autoHealActive = false
local noclipActive = false

-- Set Point Konumları
local point1 = nil
local point2 = nil

-- ----------------------------------------------------
-- 1. NOCLIP MANTIĞI
-- ----------------------------------------------------
RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if noclipActive and LocalPlayer.Character then
        for _, part in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------
-- 2. 8x8 PATLAMA VE YIKIM MANTIĞI
-- ----------------------------------------------------
local function createExplosionEffect(targetCFrame)
    local spawnBlock = Instance.new("Part")
    spawnBlock.Name = "DestructionBlock8x8"
    spawnBlock.Size = Vector3.new(8, 8, 8)
    spawnBlock.CFrame = targetCFrame
    spawnBlock.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
    spawnBlock.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    spawnBlock.Anchored = true
    spawnBlock.CanCollide = false
    spawnBlock.Parent = workspace

    local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
    explosion.Position = targetCFrame.Position
    explosion.BlastRadius = 16
    explosion.BlastPressure = 1000000
    explosion.Parent = workspace

    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, spawnBlock}
    end

    local partsInZone = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(targetCFrame, Vector3.new(8, 8, 8), overlapParams)

    for _, part in pairs(partsInZone) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and part.Name ~= "Terrain" then
            if not part:IsGrounded() or part.Anchored then
                part.Anchored = false
            end
            part:BreakJoints()
            task.spawn(function()
                part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark orange")
                task.wait(0.1)
                part:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end

    task.delay(0.5, function()
        if spawnBlock and spawnBlock.Parent then
            spawnBlock:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

-- ----------------------------------------------------
-- 3. ROKET EŞYASI (TOOL) OLUŞTURMA
-- ----------------------------------------------------
local function giveRocketTool()
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("Backpack")
    
    if backpack:FindFirstChild("🚀 8x8 Yıkım Roketi") or (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("🚀 8x8 Yıkım Roketi")) then
        return
    end

    local rocketTool = Instance.new("Tool")
    rocketTool.Name = "🚀 8x8 Yıkım Roketi"
    rocketTool.ToolTip = "8x8 Blok Fırlatır ve Alanı Yok Eder!"
    rocketTool.RequiresHandle = true
    rocketTool.Parent = backpack

    local handle = Instance.new("Part")
    handle.Name = "Handle"
    handle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 3)
    handle.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
    handle.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    handle.Parent = rocketTool

    rocketTool.Activated:Connect(function()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("Head") then return end

        local missile = Instance.new("Part")
        missile.Name = "RocketMissile"
        missile.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 2.5)
        missile.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow")
        missile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        missile.CFrame = CFrame.new(handle.Position, Mouse.Hit.Position)
        missile.CanCollide = false
        missile.Parent = workspace

        local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
        fire.Size = 4
        fire.Heat = 12
        fire.Parent = missile

        local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = (Mouse.Hit.Position - handle.Position).Unit * 200
        bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
        bodyVelocity.Parent = missile

        local touched = false
        missile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
            if touched or hit:IsDescendantOf(character) or hit.Name == "Handle" then return end
            touched = true

            local impactCFrame = missile.CFrame
            missile:Destroy()
            
            createExplosionEffect(impactCFrame)
        end)

        task.delay(5, function()
            if missile and missile.Parent then missile:Destroy() end
        end)
    end)
end

-- ----------------------------------------------------

-- ----------------------------------------------------

screenGui.Name = "UltimateControlGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

title.Parent = mainFrame

-- Helper fonksiyon: Küçük Buton Oluşturucu
local function createBtn(text, pos, size, bgCol)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = size or UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 22)
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = bgCol or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.TextSize = 9
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    btn.Parent = mainFrame
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    return btn
end

local noclipBtn = createBtn("👻 NOCLIP: KAPALI", UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 100), UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 22), Color3.fromRGB(160, 40, 40))
local tpBtn = createBtn("🌀 TIKLADIĞIN YERE TP", UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 125), UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 22), Color3.fromRGB(110, 30, 180))

-- SET POINT 1 & 2 BUTONLARI (Çiftli satırlar)
local setPoint1Btn = createBtn("📍 Set Point 1 Çek", UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 152), UDim2.new(0, 78, 0, 20), Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 180))
local tpPoint1Btn = createBtn("📍 Point 1 TP", UDim2.new(0, 92, 0, 152), UDim2.new(0, 78, 0, 20), Color3.fromRGB(0, 80, 140))

local setPoint2Btn = createBtn("📍 Set Point 2 Çek", UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 175), UDim2.new(0, 78, 0, 20), Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 180))
local tpPoint2Btn = createBtn("📍 Point 2 TP", UDim2.new(0, 92, 0, 175), UDim2.new(0, 78, 0, 20), Color3.fromRGB(0, 80, 140))

-- HIZ AYARLARI (+ / -)
local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
speedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 16)
speedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 198)
speedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
speedLabel.Text = "Hız: " .. walkSpeedVal
speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
speedLabel.TextSize = 10
speedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
speedLabel.Parent = mainFrame

jumpLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 16)
jumpLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 238)
jumpLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
jumpLabel.Text = "Zıplama Hak: " .. maxJumps .. "x"
jumpLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
jumpLabel.TextSize = 10
jumpLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
jumpLabel.Parent = mainFrame

local function fillHealth()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth end
    end
end

local function applyStats(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkSpeedVal
    humanoid.UseJumpPower = true

    humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
        if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then jumpCount = 0 end
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if autoHealActive then fillHealth() end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    task.wait(0.5)
    applyStats(char)
    giveRocketTool()
end)

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    applyStats(LocalPlayer.Character)
    giveRocketTool()
end

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and jumpCount < maxJumps then
            jumpCount = jumpCount + 1
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end
end)

healBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fillHealth)

autoHealBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    autoHealBtn.Text = autoHealActive and "🔄 OTO CAN: AÇIK" or "🔄 OTO CAN: KAPALI"

end)

noclipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    noclipActive = not noclipActive
    noclipBtn.Text = noclipActive and "👻 NOCLIP: AÇIK" or "👻 NOCLIP: KAPALI"

end)

tpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    end
end)

-- Set Point 1 Mantığı
setPoint1Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        point1 = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        setPoint1Btn.Text = "📍 Point 1 Alındı!"
        task.delay(1.5, function() setPoint1Btn.Text = "📍 Set Point 1 Çek" end)
    end
end)

tpPoint1Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and point1 then
        char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = point1
    end
end)

-- Set Point 2 Mantığı
setPoint2Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        point2 = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        setPoint2Btn.Text = "📍 Point 2 Alındı!"
        task.delay(1.5, function() setPoint2Btn.Text = "📍 Set Point 2 Çek" end)
    end
end)

tpPoint2Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and point2 then
        char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = point2
    end
end)

-- Hız Artır / Azalt
speedPlus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    walkSpeedVal = walkSpeedVal + 10
    speedLabel.Text = "Hız: " .. walkSpeedVal
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkSpeedVal
    end
end)

speedMinus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if walkSpeedVal > 10 then
        walkSpeedVal = walkSpeedVal - 10
        speedLabel.Text = "Hız: " .. walkSpeedVal
        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkSpeedVal
        end
    end
end)

-- Zıplama Artır / Azalt
jumpPlus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    maxJumps = maxJumps + 2
    jumpLabel.Text = "Zıplama Hak: " .. maxJumps .. "x"
end)

jumpMinus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if maxJumps > 1 then
        maxJumps = maxJumps - 2
        jumpLabel.Text = "Zıplama Hak: " .. maxJumps .. "x"
    end
end)

local function doHop()
    print("[neon team] looking for a server...")
    local placeId = game.PlaceId
    local currentJob = game.JobId

    local url = string.format(
        "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%d/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100",
        placeId
    )

    local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(url))
    end)

    if ok and decoded and decoded.data then
        local pool = {}
        for _, s in ipairs(decoded.data) do
            if s.id and s.id ~= currentJob and s.playing < s.maxPlayers then
                pool[#pool + 1] = s.id
            end
        end

        if #pool > 0 then
            local pick = pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
            print("[neon team] hopping to " .. pick)
            local ok2 = pcall(function()
                TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, pick, LocalPlayer)
            end)
            if ok2 then return end
        else
            print("[neon team] no free servers, trying same place")
        end
    else
        print("[neon team] http failed, trying same place")
    end

    pcall(function()
        TeleportService:Teleport(placeId, LocalPlayer)
    end)
end

local function tickTags()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == LocalPlayer then continue end
        if TEAM_CHECK and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
            killTag(plr)
            continue
        end

        local char = plr.Character
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        if char and head and hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 and myRoot then
            local dist = (hrp.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist <= ESP_RANGE then
                if not nameTags[plr] or not nameTags[plr].name.Parent then
                    killTag(plr)
                    addTag(plr)
                end
                local t = nameTags[plr]
                if t then
                    if t.name.Adornee ~= head then t.name.Adornee = head end
                    if t.dist.Adornee ~= hrp then t.dist.Adornee = hrp end
                    t.distLbl.Text = string.format("%d m", math.floor(dist))
                    local fade = math.clamp(dist / ESP_RANGE, 0, 1) * 0.4
                    t.nameLbl.TextTransparency = fade
                    t.distLbl.TextTransparency = fade
                end
            else
                killTag(plr)
            end
        else
            killTag(plr)
        end
    end
end

local function tickEsp()
    if not espOn then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end
    local myPos = myRoot.Position

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == LocalPlayer then continue end

        if TEAM_CHECK and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
            killHighlight(plr)
            continue
        end

        local char = plr.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        if char and hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
            local dist = (hrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude
            if dist <= ESP_RANGE then
                local hl = addHighlight(plr)
                if hl and hl.Adornee ~= char then hl.Adornee = char end
                if hl then
                    local t = dist / ESP_RANGE
                    hl.FillTransparency = 0.4 + t * 0.4
                end
            else
                killHighlight(plr)
            end
        else
            killHighlight(plr)
        end
    end

    tickTags()
end

local function score(plr)
    local char = plr.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not head or not hrp then return nil end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    local worldDist = (hrp.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
    if worldDist > AIM_MAX_DIST then return nil end

    local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
    if not onScreen then return nil end

    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local screenDist = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
    if screenDist > AIM_FOV then return nil end

    local look = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
    local dir  = (head.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Unit
    local dot  = look:Dot(dir)
    if dot < AIM_FRONT_BIAS then return nil end

    if AIM_WALL_CHECK then
        local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
        local ray = Ray.new(origin, head.Position - origin)
        local ignore = { LocalPlayer.Character, char }
        local hit = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, ignore, false, true)
        if hit then return nil end
    end

    return screenDist - dot * 200
end

local function bestTarget()
    local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == LocalPlayer or not alive(plr) then continue end
        if AIM_TEAM_CHECK and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then continue end
        local s = score(plr)
        if s and s < bestScore then
            bestScore = s
            best = plr
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function targetHead()
    if not target or not alive(target) then return nil end
    local char = target.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    return head and head.Position or nil
end

local function watchKills(plr)
    if plr == LocalPlayer then return end

    local function attach(char)
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if not hum then return end

        keep(hum.Died:Connect(function()
            local play = false

            if KILL_SOUND_MODE == "target" then
                if target == plr then play = true end
            elseif KILL_SOUND_MODE == "nearby" then
                local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if myRoot and hrp then
                    if (hrp.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude <= KILL_SOUND_RADIUS then
                        play = true
                    end
                end
            elseif KILL_SOUND_MODE == "confirm" then
                if target == plr and (tick() - lastShot) <= KILL_CONFIRM_WINDOW then
                    play = true
                end
            end

            if play then
                playKillSound()
                print("[neon team] kill: " .. plr.Name)
            end
        end))
    end

    if plr.Character then attach(plr.Character) end
    keep(plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(attach))
end

local function onJoin(plr)
    watchKills(plr)
    keep(plr.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        killHighlight(plr)
        killTag(plr)
        if target == plr then target = nil end
    end))
end

local function onLeave(plr)
    killHighlight(plr)
    killTag(plr)
    if target == plr then target = nil end
end

keep(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin))
keep(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onLeave))
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do onJoin(plr) end

local function shutdown()
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    conns = {}

    clearHighlights()
    clearTags()

    if wmGui then wmGui:Destroy() wmGui = nil end
    if hopGui then hopGui:Destroy() hopGui = nil end
    if killSoundInst then killSoundInst:Destroy() killSoundInst = nil end

    espOn = false
    aimOn = false
    target = nil
    wmStatus = nil
    hopOpen = false

    print("[neon team] unloaded. cya.")
end

keep(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end

    if hopOpen then
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
            hideHop()
            print("[neon team] hop cancelled")
        elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Y then
            hideHop()
            doHop()
        elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then
            shutdown()
        end
        return
    end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then
        shutdown()

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.L then
        showHop()
        print("[neon team] hop prompt shown")

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
        espOn = not espOn
        if not espOn then
            clearHighlights()
            clearTags()
        end
        print("[neon team] esp " .. (espOn and "on" or "off"))
        refreshStatus()

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
        aimOn = not aimOn
        if aimOn then
            target = bestTarget()
            lastSwitch = tick()
            if target then
                print("[neon team] locked " .. target.Name)
            else
                print("[neon team] nothing visible in front")
                aimOn = false
            end
        else
            target = nil
            print("[neon team] unlocked")
        end
        refreshStatus()

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.K then
        SMOOTH_ON = not SMOOTH_ON
        print(string.format("[neon team] smooth %s (%.2f)", SMOOTH_ON and "on" or "off", SMOOTH_FACTOR))
        refreshStatus()

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftBracket then
        SMOOTH_FACTOR = math.max(SMOOTH_MIN, SMOOTH_FACTOR - SMOOTH_STEP)
        print(string.format("[neon team] smooth factor %.2f", SMOOTH_FACTOR))

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket then
        SMOOTH_FACTOR = math.min(SMOOTH_MAX, SMOOTH_FACTOR + SMOOTH_STEP)
        print(string.format("[neon team] smooth factor %.2f", SMOOTH_FACTOR))
    end
end))

keep(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        lastShot = tick()
    end
end))

keep(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not espOn then return end
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastEspTick < ESP_REFRESH then return end
    lastEspTick = now
    pcall(tickEsp)
end))

keep(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not aimOn then return end
    local now = tick()

    if not target or not alive(target) or (now - lastSwitch >= AIM_SWITCH_DELAY) then
        local best = bestTarget()
        if best and best ~= target then
            target = best
            lastSwitch = now
        elseif not best then
            target = nil
            return
        end
    end

    local head = targetHead()
    if head then
        local desired = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, head)
        if SMOOTH_ON then
            Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(desired, SMOOTH_FACTOR)
        else
            Camera.CFrame = desired
        end
    end
end))

initKillSound()
buildWatermark()
refreshStatus()

local GrabRange, AimCone = 999, 999
local DogsFolderName = "NPCs"
local FlingDuration, FlingSpeed, AimRate = 2, 9999, 9999
local MaxChain, ChainDelay = 1, 0
local holding, flinging, chaining, stopChain = nil, false, false, false


local function getRay()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local isFirstPerson = head and (cam.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude <= 1.5
    if isTouchDevice or isFirstPerson then
        return cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector
    end
    return Mouse.UnitRay.Origin, Mouse.UnitRay.Direction
end


local function pickDog(preferAim)
    local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild(DogsFolderName)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (folder and hrp) then return nil end
    local origin, direction = getRay()
    local bestDog, bestScore = nil, math.huge
    for _, dog in folder:GetChildren() do
        local humanoid = dog:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local torso = dog:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and torso then
            local dist = (torso.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            if dist <= GrabRange then
                local score = dist
                if preferAim then
                    local toDog = (torso.Position - origin).Unit
                    local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(direction:Dot(toDog), -1, 1))
                    if not isTouchDevice and Mouse.Target and Mouse.Target:IsDescendantOf(dog) then angle = -1 end
                    score = angle < math.rad(AimCone) and angle or dist + 100
                end
                if score < bestScore then bestDog, bestScore = dog, score end
            end
        end
    end
    if bestDog then return bestDog, (bestDog.Torso.Position - origin).Magnitude end
    return nil
end


local function getClosestOtherDog(exclude)
    local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild(DogsFolderName)
    if not folder then return nil end
    local heldTorso = exclude and exclude:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not heldTorso then return nil end
    local closest, closestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, dog in folder:GetChildren() do
        if dog ~= exclude then
            local humanoid = dog:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local torso = dog:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and torso then
                local dist = (torso.Position - heldTorso.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < closestDist and dist < 130 then closest, closestDist = dog, dist end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end


local function release()
    if not holding then return end
    holding, flinging = nil, false
    pcall(function() Net:Fire("Manipulator", "Release") end)
end


local function startFling(dog)
    flinging = true
    local startTime = os.clock()
    while holding and flinging and not stopChain and os.clock() - startTime < FlingDuration do
        local target = getClosestOtherDog(dog)
        local heldTorso = dog:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        if heldTorso then
            if target and target:FindFirstChild("Torso") then
                local dir = (target.Torso.Position - heldTorso.Position)
                dir = dir.Magnitude > 0.1 and dir.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
                pcall(function() Net:Fire("Manipulator", "Aim", target.Torso.Position + dir * 20) end)
                pcall(function() heldTorso.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * FlingSpeed + Vector3.new(0, 55, 0) end)
            else
                pcall(function()
                    Net:Fire("Manipulator", "Aim", heldTorso.Position + Vector3.new(0, 90, 0))
                    heldTorso.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 350, 0)
                end)
            end
        end
        task.wait(1 / AimRate)
    end

-- ========== FLY LOGIC ==========
local function getCharacterParts()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return char, root, hum
end

local function stopFly()
	flying = false
	if flyConnection then
		flyConnection:Disconnect()
		flyConnection = nil
	end
	if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
	if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end

	local _, _, hum = getCharacterParts()
	if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end

	flyBtn.Text = "Fly: OFF"
	flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
end

local function startFly()
	local _, root, hum = getCharacterParts()
	if not root or not hum then return end

	flying = true
	hum.PlatformStand = true

	bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bodyVelocity.Parent = root

	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bodyGyro.P = 9e4
	bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root

	flyBtn.Text = "Fly: ON"
	flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 90)

	flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local _, r, h = getCharacterParts()
		if not r or not h or not bodyVelocity then
			stopFly()
			return
		end

		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local camCF = camera.CFrame
		local direction = Vector3.zero

		-- WASD / mobile thumbstick (relative to where the camera looks)
		local moveDir = h.MoveDirection
		if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camCF.LookVector.X, 0, camCF.LookVector.Z)
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(camCF.RightVector.X, 0, camCF.RightVector.Z)
			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then flatLook = flatLook.Unit end
			if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.001 then flatRight = flatRight.Unit end
			local forwardAmt = moveDir:Dot(flatLook)
			local rightAmt = moveDir:Dot(flatRight)
			direction = camCF.LookVector * forwardAmt + camCF.RightVector * rightAmt
		end

		-- Up / down (only when not typing in a textbox)
		if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
				direction += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
				or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
				direction -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
		end

		if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
			direction = direction.Unit
		end

		bodyVelocity.Velocity = direction * flySpeed
		bodyGyro.CFrame = camCF
	end)
end

local function toggleFly()
	if flying then
		stopFly()
	else
		startFly()
	end
end

local dragging, dragStart, startPos

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)
